findings.title: Feature-flagged table visualization discards query results
findings.body: In `tableResultComponent`, when the organization has `use-table-widget-visualization`, the code renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}} />`. It ignores `result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`, `fieldAliases`, and the custom field renderers already computed for the widget, so every dashboard table widget for such organizations will show an empty table instead of its query results.

findings.title: Mutual exclusion validation uses truthiness and misses zero values
findings.body: `validate_timestamp` checks `if self.initial_data.get("age")`, and `validate_age` checks `if self.initial_data.get("timestamp")`. Because `0` is falsy, a report containing both `age` and `timestamp` will be accepted when one of them is `0` (for example `timestamp: 0` and `age: 1`). The two spec formats are supposed to be mutually exclusive; use key presence (`"age" in self.initial_data`) instead of truthiness.

findings.title: No-op migration references missing replacement migration
findings.body: Both this migration and `0920_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_revised.py` have been changed to no-op functions with comments pointing to `0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py`, but no `0921` migration is included in this PR. If `0921` is not already present in the target branch, the saved-search-to-`GroupSearchView` conversion will never run while the no-op migrations are recorded as applied, leaving organization saved searches unconverted.
